label: Read over write
subgoals: Compare the read address with the outermost store's address
Return the stored value on a match, otherwise move to the inner array
Return the initial content when every store misses

label: Symbolic addresses
subgoals: Compare the read index with the outer store index first
Resolve each comparison that is known to be equal or different
Leave an ite for every comparison that is unknown

label: Arrays as memories in hardware proofs
section: Arrays as memories in hardware proofs
subgoals: Use extensionality to compare whole arrays
Model each write as a store and each read as a select over the store chain
Treat a memory abstraction as an over-approximation
